item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya stirs a spoonful of sugar into a glass of water until the sugar disappears completely. She finds that every sip from the glass tastes equally sweet, and no separate layer of sugar can be seen anywhere in the water.

Why is this mixture classified as a solution?

options.A: Because two substances are present together in the glass
options.B: Because the sugar was stirred into the water with a spoon
options.C: Because sugar and water are both pure substances
options.D: Because the sugar is evenly distributed throughout the water
